en: You have fought hard to invade the realm of the harvester.
Take a break, men! Half hour and then back to work.
I trust very few of your kind, $n. But I can tell that you are a friend.
%s cries for help.

I know many things, stranger, but your knowledge rivals my own. Enchanters who wish to hone their skills further are known to travel to the Tower of Azora, where an artisan named Kitta Firewind resides.
But this can't be right. Where did I put that other book?
Half way there...
Our work is done. Now we wait on the Alliance to finish theirs before shipping everything over to Silithus.

The tinkerer's craft for you is it?  No doubt ye'll want to go see Springspindle Fizzlegear in Tinker Town.  

Just head east from the gates of Ironforge, or follow the sound of the explosions.

Och, 'twas a sad day when I realized my obsession. I woke up and found myself tannin' before I had my first tankard of ale. Hardly even a respectable hangover! I knew then--aye, I knew!--how it was goin' to be.
Lysheana can offer you the proper documents, she resides in the Craftsmen's Terrace in northeasten Darnassus.  May your fellowship bring glory to the Night Elves!
FOR KALIMDOR!
You want to learn how to make a campfire?  Well then you had best see Malygen in the Cenarion Enclave before you set fire to Teldrassil itself.
Tower Point is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will destroy it!

Hail, $r! I am Lieutenant Haggerdin, officer in charge of recruitment for the Stormpike Guard.$B$BAs you gain prestige and notoriety among the Stormpike, return to me and I shall see about upgrading your insignia. Also, should you ever lose your insignia, I am able to supply a replacement.
Left Combat
to arms laddies!

The Thorium Brotherhood possesses the knowledge required to make the sacred arms and armaments of the Fire Lord, but we lack the manpower to obtain the materials required for the crafting.$B$BI, Lokhtos Darkbargainer, have been empowered by the Brotherhood to exchange the exalted recipes for materials gathered from the Molten Core.$B$BPresent your offer, $r.

The theory behind it is that we completely destroy you with a massive explosion wherever you are and send those particles through a dimensional rip and then re-implode you at the machine here.   Instant Transport!    It might not work ALL the time, but what kind of goblin engineer are you!   If survival was your first priority you could never be a real Goblin Engineer!
Here is the recipe you will need to make the Dimensional Ripper and try it out!
Majesty, run while you still can. She is not what you think her to be...

All of the fish and everything else is on its way to Silithus, and should be there in less than $2113w days. After that someone's going to have to ring that gong with the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to start the war.
If you want the key, you'll have to catch me!
James Van Brunt in War Quarter on inner ring.
When preparing the dragon's meal, be sure to torture the prisoner in view of the dragon.  It responds well to pre-meal entertainment.

Have you come here for instruction in the art of making potions? You were mistaken if you thought that I would offer such a privilege to you, unearned. Go, and do not return to me until you have greater skill.
Next time, bring more friends!
Filthy Frostwolf cowards! If you want a fight, you'll have to come to me!
I doubt you will be so lucky the next time you encounter my bretheren.
Ah, empty again!
You land lubbers are tougher than I thought! I'll have to improvise!
The Bank of Orgrimmar is in the Valley of Strength. Look for it north of the main entrance to the city.
Red is the winner! Congratulations Red!

Herbs, herbs, hmmm, let me see here. Ah yes, here it is. To date we have accumulated $2047w out of $2048w stranglekelp, $2053w out of $2055w purple lotuses, and $2057w out of $2058w arthas' tears needed.
Captain, here they come! The naga are coming!
